title: Banking Regulator Races to Finalize GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules
snippet: OCC Comptroller Jonathan Gould told the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium the agency is moving at a rapid pace to beat a January statutory deadline, after already missing an earlier July target.

title: Cybersecurity firm unveils crypto phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers
snippet: Rapid7 unveiled a new cryptocurrency phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers, aiming to steal investors’ holdings by redirecting them to fake wallet provider websites.
